questions.question: What is our 30-day hospital-wide readmission rate?
questions.definition: Unplanned inpatient readmissions within 30 days of discharge from an index admission, divided by eligible index discharges, risk-adjusted. Planned readmissions and specified exclusions are removed.
requiredData: planned versus unplanned flag or diagnosis and procedure codes

questions.question: Which conditions drive our readmissions (heart attack, heart failure, pneumonia, COPD, hip or knee replacement, bypass)?
questions.metric: Condition-specific 30-day readmission rates and excess readmission ratio
questions.definition: Readmission rates for the Medicare target conditions: acute myocardial infarction, heart failure, pneumonia, COPD, elective hip and knee replacement, and coronary artery bypass graft.
requiredData: principal diagnosis and procedure codes (ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS)

questions.question: What is our 30-day mortality after a heart attack, heart failure or pneumonia?
questions.definition: Deaths from any cause within 30 days of admission for the condition, risk-standardised.
requiredData: date of death (hospital or linked vital-status source)

questions.question: What is our in-hospital mortality rate, and is it better or worse than expected?
questions.definition: Inpatient deaths divided by discharges, compared with the expected count from a risk model (observed/expected ratio).

questions.question: Are we meeting the sepsis bundle?
questions.definition: Share of eligible severe sepsis and septic shock cases receiving every bundle element on time (lactate, cultures, antibiotics, fluids, reassessment).

references.title: SEP-1 Severe Sepsis and Septic Shock: Management Bundle

requiredData: order and administration times for lactate, blood cultures, antibiotics, fluids

questions.question: How are we doing on stroke care?
questions.metric: Stroke measure set compliance and door-to-needle time
questions.definition: Share of eligible ischemic stroke patients meeting each stroke process measure; median time from arrival to thrombolytic.

questions.question: What is our patient safety composite score?
questions.definition: Weighted composite of selected patient safety indicators (for example pressure ulcer, perioperative hemorrhage, postoperative sepsis, postoperative respiratory failure, perioperative DVT/PE).
requiredData: inpatient claims or abstracts with diagnoses and procedures (with present-on-admission indicators)

questions.question: What is our surgical complication rate?
questions.definition: Surgical cases with a defined complication within the measure window, divided by surgical cases.

references.title: ACS National Surgical Quality Improvement Program (NSQIP)

requiredData: surgical case records with procedure codes

questions.question: Are our outcomes better or worse than similar hospitals?
questions.metric: Outcome measures against national or peer benchmark
questions.definition: Any quality measure shown beside a national or peer-group benchmark with the benchmark source and period.

references.title: Hospital Compare / Care Compare overall star rating

requiredData: a licensed or public benchmark dataset loaded with its version and period

questions.question: What is our hospital-acquired infection rate overall?
questions.metric: Healthcare-associated infection rate and standardized infection ratio
questions.definition: Healthcare-associated infections per 1,000 device days or procedures, and the ratio of observed to predicted infections.

references.title: National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) Standardized Infection Ratio (SIR)

requiredData: infection surveillance events with NHSN definitions
device days and patient days by unit

questions.question: How many central line bloodstream infections have we had?
questions.definition: Central line-associated bloodstream infections per 1,000 central line days.

references.title: NHSN CLABSI event protocol and SIR

questions.question: How many catheter-associated urinary tract infections have we had?
questions.definition: Catheter-associated urinary tract infections per 1,000 urinary catheter days.

references.title: NHSN CAUTI event protocol and SIR

questions.question: What is our surgical site infection rate?
questions.metric: Surgical site infection rate and SIR by procedure
questions.definition: Surgical site infections divided by procedures in the NHSN procedure categories (for example colon surgery, abdominal hysterectomy).

references.title: NHSN Surgical Site Infection (SSI) event protocol and SIR

requiredData: operative procedure records with NHSN procedure categories

questions.question: How many C. difficile and MRSA infections have we had?
questions.metric: C. difficile and MRSA bacteremia laboratory-identified events and SIR
questions.definition: Hospital-onset C. difficile and MRSA bacteremia events per 10,000 patient days.

references.title: NHSN Multidrug-Resistant Organism and C. difficile Infection (MDRO/CDI) module

requiredData: laboratory-identified events with specimen date and admission date

questions.question: How many patient falls with injury have we had?
questions.metric: Falls with injury per 1,000 patient days
questions.definition: Inpatient falls resulting in injury divided by patient days, by unit.

questions.question: How many pressure injuries have developed in our care?
questions.metric: Hospital-acquired stage 3 or 4 pressure injury rate
questions.definition: Stage 3, stage 4 and unstageable pressure injuries not present on admission, per discharges.

references.title: Patient Safety Indicator 03 (PSI 03), Pressure Ulcer Rate

questions.question: How many medication errors and adverse drug events are we seeing?
questions.metric: Medication error and adverse drug event rate by severity
questions.definition: Reported medication errors and adverse drug events per 1,000 patient days, categorised by harm.

references.title: NCC MERP Index for Categorizing Medication Errors
references.body: National Coordinating Council for Medication Error Reporting and Prevention

references.title: Global Trigger Tool for Measuring Adverse Events

requiredData: medication event reports with harm category

questions.question: Have we had any sentinel events or never events?
questions.metric: Sentinel and never event count with review status
questions.definition: Count of reviewable sentinel events and serious reportable events, with root-cause-analysis status.
requiredData: event register with event type, date and review status

questions.question: How is our incident reporting trending?
questions.metric: Incident reports per 1,000 patient days by category and harm
questions.definition: Count of safety incident reports by category and harm level, per patient days.
requiredData: incident reports with category, harm level, date and unit

questions.question: Are staff cleaning their hands?
questions.definition: Observed hand hygiene opportunities with compliant action divided by observed opportunities.

references.title: WHO Guidelines on Hand Hygiene in Health Care

requiredData: observation audit records with opportunity and action

questions.question: Are we preventing blood clots in surgical and medical patients?
questions.metric: VTE prophylaxis compliance and hospital-acquired VTE rate
questions.definition: Share of eligible patients with VTE prophylaxis by the day after admission; perioperative DVT or PE per discharges.

questions.question: How long are patients in our emergency department?
questions.metric: Median time from ED arrival to departure
questions.definition: Median minutes from ED arrival to departure for discharged patients, and separately for admitted patients.

references.title: OP-18 Median Time from ED Arrival to ED Departure for Discharged ED Patients

requiredData: ED arrival, provider, disposition and departure timestamps

questions.question: How long until a patient is seen by a provider in the ED?
questions.definition: Median minutes from ED arrival to first provider contact.
requiredData: ED arrival and first provider timestamps

questions.question: What share of ED patients leave without being seen?
questions.definition: ED patients who left before a provider evaluation divided by ED arrivals.

questions.question: How long do admitted patients board in the ED?
questions.definition: Median and 90th-percentile minutes from admission decision to ED departure.

references.title: Boarding of admitted patients in the ED (policy statement)

questions.question: What is our bed occupancy?
questions.definition: Midnight census divided by staffed beds, by unit.

questions.question: What is our average length of stay, and is it longer than expected?
questions.metric: Average length of stay versus geometric mean length of stay
questions.definition: Mean inpatient days per discharge compared with the geometric mean length of stay for the MS-DRG.

references.title: MS-DRG Geometric Mean Length of Stay (GMLOS), IPPS final rule tables

questions.closest: Claim volume by practice and provider is available, but billing data has no admission and discharge dates, so length of stay cannot be computed from it.

questions.question: How many patients are discharged before noon?
questions.definition: Discharges with a departure time before noon divided by all discharges.

questions.question: How long do new patients wait for an appointment?
questions.metric: Third next available appointment and new-patient wait
questions.definition: Days to the third next available appointment by clinic and specialty; days from request to new-patient visit.

questions.question: What is our appointment no-show rate?
questions.definition: Appointments marked no-show or cancelled within the cut-off divided by scheduled appointments.

questions.question: How well are we using our operating rooms?
questions.metric: Operating room utilization, first-case on-time starts and turnover time
questions.definition: Used minutes divided by available block minutes; share of first cases starting on time; minutes between cases.
requiredData: OR schedule and actual in-room and out-room times

questions.question: How many patients are we transferring out or diverting?
questions.definition: Patients transferred to another facility, and hours on diversion, with reason.
requiredData: transfer records with reason and destination

questions.question: How many patients did we admit, discharge and treat in the period?
questions.definition: Count of inpatient admissions and discharges, and total patient days, by facility and service line.

questions.question: How many outpatient and ED visits did we have?
questions.definition: Count of completed outpatient encounters and ED visits, by clinic, specialty and facility.
requiredData: encounter records with class, status, date and location
questions.closest: Claim lines by rendering provider are available in claim volume, but they count billed lines, not visits.

questions.question: What surgeries and procedures do we perform most?
questions.metric: Procedure volume by procedure and surgeon
questions.definition: Count of completed procedures by CPT or ICD-10-PCS code, specialty and surgeon.
requiredData: procedure records with codes, date and performing provider
questions.closest: CPT performance from billing claims is planned (catalogue V4); it counts billed procedures, not clinical records.

questions.question: What is our case mix index?
questions.definition: Average MS-DRG relative weight across discharges in the period.

references.title: MS-DRG relative weights, IPPS final rule tables

requiredData: annual relative-weight table loaded with its fiscal year

questions.question: How much imaging and laboratory testing are we doing?
questions.metric: Imaging and laboratory order and result volume
questions.definition: Count of imaging studies and laboratory tests ordered and resulted, by modality or test group.
requiredData: order and result records with modality or test code and dates

questions.question: How much of our care is by telehealth?
questions.definition: Telehealth encounters divided by all outpatient encounters.
requiredData: encounters with visit modality or place-of-service code
questions.closest: Claim lines carry place-of-service, so a billing-based approximation is possible (catalogue V6).

questions.question: How many patients came back to the ED within 72 hours?
questions.definition: ED patients returning to the ED within 72 hours of a discharge, divided by ED discharges.
requiredData: ED encounters with patient identifier and times

questions.question: What does it cost us to treat a patient, by condition?
questions.definition: Total direct and indirect cost for the stay, from cost accounting, divided by discharges, by MS-DRG.

questions.question: What are our supply and drug costs per case?
questions.metric: Supply and drug cost per case
questions.definition: Supply and pharmaceutical cost allocated to cases, divided by cases, by procedure and surgeon.
requiredData: supply chain and pharmacy cost by case

questions.question: How much does avoidable readmission or an extended stay cost us?
questions.metric: Cost of readmissions and avoidable days
questions.definition: Cost of readmissions and of days above the expected length of stay.
requiredData: readmission and length-of-stay data (see C-QL-01, C-AT-06)

questions.question: What is our margin by service line?
questions.definition: Net revenue minus direct cost, by service line.
questions.closest: Net revenue pieces exist in billing (catalogue F-themes) but cost data does not.

questions.question: How many of our diabetic patients have poorly controlled blood sugar?
questions.metric: Diabetes glycemic status: HbA1c above 9% rate
questions.definition: Patients 18-75 with diabetes whose most recent HbA1c in the year is above 9% or missing, divided by patients with diabetes.

references.title: Glycemic Status Assessment for Patients With Diabetes (GSD)

questions.question: Is our patients' blood pressure under control?
questions.definition: Patients 18-85 with hypertension whose most recent blood pressure is below 140/90, divided by patients with hypertension.

questions.question: What share of eligible patients are up to date on cancer screening?
questions.metric: Breast, colorectal and cervical cancer screening rates
questions.definition: Eligible patients with a screening in the measure window, divided by eligible patients.

references.title: Breast Cancer Screening (BCS-E), Colorectal Cancer Screening (COL-E), Cervical Cancer Screening (CCS)

requiredData: eligible-population definition by age and sex
screening procedures and results with dates

questions.question: What are our immunization rates?
questions.definition: Patients up to date on the recommended vaccine series, divided by eligible patients.

references.title: Childhood Immunization Status (CIS) and Adult Immunization Status (AIS-E)

requiredData: immunization records with vaccine and date

questions.question: Do patients get follow-up care after a hospital stay?
questions.metric: Follow-up within 7 and 30 days after discharge
questions.definition: Discharged patients with a follow-up visit within 7 or 30 days, divided by eligible discharges, including follow-up after mental-illness hospitalization.

references.title: Follow-Up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness (FUH)

questions.question: How many hospital admissions could have been prevented with good outpatient care?
questions.definition: Admissions for ambulatory-care-sensitive conditions (for example diabetes complications, asthma, heart failure) per 100,000 population.

questions.question: Which patients are high-risk and need outreach?
questions.metric: Risk-stratified cohorts and open care gaps
questions.definition: Patients grouped by risk score, with open care gaps and recent utilisation; high ED users commonly defined as four or more ED visits in a year (local definition).

questions.question: How many patients have multiple chronic conditions?
questions.metric: Prevalence of chronic conditions and multimorbidity
questions.definition: Patients with each chronic condition, and with two or more, divided by active patients.

references.title: CMS Chronic Conditions Data Warehouse condition algorithms

questions.question: How do patients rate their hospital stay?
questions.metric: HCAHPS overall hospital rating and top-box scores
questions.definition: Share of respondents giving the hospital a 9 or 10, and top-box scores for communication, responsiveness and discharge information.

references.title: Hospital Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (HCAHPS)

requiredData: survey vendor extract with item responses, discharge date and unit

questions.question: Would patients recommend us?
questions.definition: Share of respondents who would definitely recommend the hospital.
requiredData: survey item responses with date and unit

questions.question: What are patients complaining about?
questions.metric: Complaints and grievances by theme and resolution time
questions.definition: Count of complaints and grievances by theme and days to resolution.
requiredData: grievance log with theme, date opened and closed

questions.question: How do clinic patients rate their provider?
questions.definition: Share of respondents giving the provider a 9 or 10, by clinic and provider.
requiredData: survey item responses by provider and clinic

questions.question: Are we safely staffed?
questions.metric: Nursing hours per patient day and nurse-to-patient ratio
questions.definition: Worked nursing hours divided by patient days, and patients per nurse by shift and unit.

references.title: NDNQI nursing hours per patient day

requiredData: timekeeping hours by role, unit and shift

questions.question: What is our staff turnover and how many positions are vacant?
questions.metric: Turnover and vacancy rates by role
questions.definition: Separations divided by average headcount, and open budgeted positions divided by budgeted positions.

references.title: National Health Care Retention & RN Staffing Report

requiredData: HR roster with hire and termination dates

questions.question: How much overtime and agency labor are we using?
questions.metric: Overtime and contract labor share of hours and cost
questions.definition: Overtime and agency hours and cost divided by total worked hours and labor cost.
requiredData: payroll hours and cost by pay type

questions.question: How productive are our physicians?
questions.definition: Work relative value units from billed procedures, per provider per FTE.

references.title: Medicare Physician Fee Schedule relative value units

questions.closest: Billed CPT per provider exists in billing; the RVU table and FTE are missing.

questions.question: Are staff credentials and competencies current?
questions.definition: Staff with expired or soon-to-expire licenses, certifications and competencies.

questions.question: Have we had any privacy breaches?
questions.metric: Privacy incidents and breaches reportable under HIPAA
questions.definition: Count of privacy incidents, breaches affecting 500 or more individuals, and notification timeliness.
requiredData: privacy incident log with date, size, type and notification dates

questions.question: Are our physicians being peer reviewed?
questions.metric: Peer review and professional practice evaluation completion
questions.definition: Completed ongoing and focused professional practice evaluations divided by those due.

references.title: Ongoing and Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE/FPPE)

requiredData: peer review records by provider with due and completion dates

questions.question: Are we ready for an accreditation survey?
questions.metric: Open audit and survey findings by standard
questions.definition: Open findings from internal audits and external surveys, by standard and due date.
requiredData: audit and survey finding register with standard, severity, owner and due date

questions.question: How many malpractice claims and lawsuits do we have?
questions.definition: Open and closed professional liability claims by service and provider, with reserves.

questions.question: Is informed consent being documented?
questions.definition: Procedures with documented informed consent before the procedure divided by procedures audited.

questions.question: How complete is our clinical documentation?
questions.metric: Chart completion and delinquent record rate
questions.definition: Charts completed within the policy window divided by discharges; count of delinquent records by provider.
requiredData: chart status with discharge date, completion date and responsible provider

questions.question: How often do we query physicians for clarification?
questions.metric: Documentation query rate and response rate
questions.definition: Queries issued per 100 discharges, and share answered and agreed.

references.title: Guidelines for Achieving a Compliant Query Practice

requiredData: query log with date, type, response and outcome

questions.question: Are we capturing the severity of our patients?
questions.definition: Discharges with a major or other complication/comorbidity code divided by eligible discharges.

questions.question: How accurate is our coding?
questions.definition: Audited records with all codes confirmed divided by records audited.

references.title: ICD-10-CM/PCS Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

requiredData: coding audit results with record, code and finding

questions.question: How many claims are denied for medical necessity?
questions.definition: Claims denied for medical necessity divided by claims submitted; links clinical documentation to billing denials.
requiredData: denial reason codes mapped to a medical-necessity group
questions.closest: Denial counts by status and reason are available now (denial analysis); reasons are not yet grouped into medical necessity.

questions.question: How much antibiotic are we using?
questions.metric: Antibiotic days of therapy per 1,000 days present
questions.definition: Antibiotic days of therapy divided by patient days present, by unit and drug class.

references.title: Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs

requiredData: medication administration records with drug, date and unit

questions.question: What is our opioid prescribing like?
questions.metric: Opioid prescribing volume and morphine milligram equivalents
questions.definition: Opioid prescriptions and average daily morphine milligram equivalents, by prescriber and diagnosis.

references.title: Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022)

requiredData: prescriptions with drug, strength, quantity and days supply

questions.question: How fast do we turn around lab results?
questions.definition: Median and 90th-percentile minutes from order or collection to result, by test and priority.
requiredData: lab order, collection and result timestamps

questions.question: Are critical lab results reported on time?
questions.definition: Critical results communicated to a responsible clinician within the policy window divided by critical results.

references.title: National Patient Safety Goal NPSG.02.03.01 (report critical results)

requiredData: critical result log with result and notification timestamps

questions.question: How fast are imaging reports finished, and how often do we repeat studies?
questions.metric: Imaging report turnaround and repeat rate
questions.definition: Median hours from exam completion to final report; repeated studies divided by studies.

questions.question: Show this patient's recent admissions.
questions.definition: The patient's inpatient stays with dates, unit and discharge disposition.

questions.question: When was this patient last seen?
questions.definition: Date, clinic and provider of the most recent completed encounter.

questions.question: What are this patient's active diagnoses?
questions.definition: Active conditions on the patient's problem list.

questions.question: What medications is this patient on?
questions.definition: Active medication orders and administrations.
requiredData: medication requests for one patient (FHIR MedicationRequest)

questions.question: Does this patient have any allergies?
questions.definition: Recorded allergies and intolerances with reaction and severity.
requiredData: allergy records for one patient (FHIR AllergyIntolerance)

questions.question: What were this patient's recent lab results?
questions.definition: Latest results by test with reference range and flags.

questions.question: What appointments does this patient have coming up?
questions.definition: Booked future appointments with clinic, provider and time.

questions.question: Does this patient have open incidents or care gaps?
questions.definition: Open safety incidents involving the patient and open care-gap measures.
